d: A URL shortener that lives on my own domain: paste a long link, get a tiny isaac1804.com/s/xxxxx back. It compresses the link itself first — stripping utm_*/fbclid/igshid/si tracking junk (and telling you what it removed, while leaving signed download URLs alone) — then stores it in Cloudflare KV with click counting, custom names, duplicate detection and QR codes. Bulk mode takes one link per line and shows the exact saving per link (was 214 chars → 33 chars, 85% smaller). Anyone can compress any link (rate limited per IP so it cannot become a spam redirector) and that is all they can do; the 🔒 admin password at the top unlocks everything else — who created each link and who clicked it (IP, city, ISP, device), deleting, custom names, the full list and unlimited links.

v.i: Worker + KV shortener routed onto isaac1804.com: 5-char codes from an alphabet with no 0/O/1/l/i, 302 redirects with click counting, same-URL reuse, admin token for custom names, deletes and stats. Tool page: bulk paste, tracking-parameter stripping with a per-link saving readout, inline QR codes, searchable/exportable history.

Compressing opened to everyone — any link, no token, because it has to work for whoever I send the tool to. Abuse guard is now a 200-links-per-hour-per-IP limit; the token only gates custom names, deleting and the full list.

Tracking: every link records who created it and every click records who opened it (IP, city/country, ISP, device, referer) — readable only with the password, in a per-link log plus a combined activity feed.

Fully admin controlled: a 🔒 Admin box at the top of the page takes the password and unlocks the logs, deleting, custom names and unlimited links — visitors can only make and follow links. Fixed Delete, which was shown to everyone and only printed an error when locked; it now appears only when unlocked, and any 401 re-asks for the password.
